Explore the midsoles
From thebottomup

Why shoes crumble like cake

Moisture in the air attacks the polymer bonds inside polyurethane midsoles, breaking them down from the inside out. Once that structure has collapsed, the sole cannot be repaired except by a sole swap.

+10
Make the good stuff last

Add 10 more years to your sneakers' life.

Preserve the upper. Replace the foundation. A degraded midsole should not have to end the life of a quality sneaker. Component-level restoration keeps more of the original pair in use, supports circular fashion, and gives meaningful shoes more miles.
